question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party, state institutions, and military as of mid-2026, with recent leadership purges and personnel reshuffles further centralizing authority under his direct oversight ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Analysts note the absence of any designated successor or organized factional challenge, alongside continued emphasis on party loyalty and national security priorities that align with his extended tenure. Trader consensus at 95.5% against removal before 2027 reflects these structural factors, including the nominal status of prior retirement norms and limited visible elite discontent capable of forcing change. Realistic scenarios that could still shift the outcome include a sudden health event, major policy failure tied to economic pressures or external crises such as Taiwan Strait escalation, or unexpected internal realignments, though available reporting shows no confirmed developments of this nature within the resolution window.
